final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT sq.arcref, p.fundflux, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc sq INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY sq.arcref, p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT fundflux, SUM(cnt) as sum_cnt FROM step1 GROUP BY fundflux), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(sum_cnt) as total FROM step2) SELECT f.fundflux, f.sum_cnt, CAST(f.sum_cnt AS REAL) / CAST(t.total AS REAL) FROM step2 f CROSS JOIN step3 t WHERE f.sum_cnt IS NOT NULL AND t.total IS NOT NULL
